children: Star Diamond recorded a Q3 2026 net loss of $872K versus $989K in Q3 2025. At September 30, cash was $73K versus $724K at December 31, 2025, and the working-capital deficit was $1.1M versus $458K of working capital.
Loss narrowed year over year, but the company remains loss-making.
Sharp cash depletion raises near-term financing risk.
The deterioration indicates current liabilities exceed current assets.
PFS work needs about $2.9M more funding
The study is delayed; remaining work is expected to take about 12 months after financing and contractor scheduling.
Company says more financing is required
The release warns failure to raise funds could force suspension of operations and planned activities.

This is a cash-constrained, pre-development diamond project, with the project site under care and maintenance and the pre-feasibility study still incomplete. A financing announcement sufficient to fund the remaining study, followed by its results, would be needed to establish a stronger development catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Star Diamond Corporation distributed by PR Newswire.
